description:
From ISS-001, 23e971e.
1. claude_sonnet.py:146: a candidate the model skipped counts as clean. Fix: it stays queued for the next Stop, like a failed parataxis run already does (claude_sonnet.py:155).
2. turn_retry.py:17,20: a row is dropped after 2 failed attempts. Fix: drop it, but tell the agent in the Stop output which rows went unreviewed and record a ledger row.
3. CLI failure cooldown of 300 s prints nothing. Fix: print one visible message naming the failure and the cooldown end, the cooldown itself stays so a broken CLI does not run every Stop.
Update CHANGELOG.

Acceptance: skipped candidate re-queued; dropped rows named in output; cooldown message visible. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Treat an unreviewed Sonnet candidate as unreviewed, not clean
